title: Open-source compatibility: verify the patch, then review release status during the window
brief: Xingzhou 1.4.1 fails under compiler C19; logs LOG-771 are ready. First confirm reproduction and a verified patch, then follow up release candidate status and the stable release date during the first-quarter 2027 release window. Obtain the written stable-version determination through the project's registration channel. An interim patch does not complete the task. Do not merge or release.

pages.title: Xingzhou project contribution guide
pages.text: The maintainer handles messages Monday, Wednesday, and Friday from 20:00 to 22:00; CI runs continuously for 48 hours. Releases are quarterly, with candidate and stable-version status checked at each upstream compatibility window. Neither a patch nor a release candidate constitutes a stable version. The upcoming release plan and other documents are attached to this page.
pages.snippet: Open-source project maintenance schedule and release cadence.

pages.title: Xingzhou project contacts
pages.text: Contact maintainer Jian Chuan for compatibility issues and patch coordination; see the corresponding information pages for other contact routes.

pages.title: Xingzhou project release process
pages.text: Quarterly release review must be forwarded through the maintainer. This quarter's upstream compatibility window is February 9, 2027 at 20:00. Release status verification must reference a verified patch. This page explains the process only and cannot merge or release online.
pages.snippet: Quarterly release review process and window information.

pages.title: Xingzhou project issue reporting portal
pages.text: Compatibility issue reports require the version, compiler, and log ID. Patch verification and release status are checked in separate phases. Obtain written release status determinations through this page's registration form. This page only explains requirements and cannot merge or release online.
pages.snippet: Xingzhou project issue reporting requirements and release status registration form; no online merging.

form.title: Release status registration application
form.submit_instructions: This form cannot be submitted directly online. Use the Xingzhou release status registration channel; see the latest project release process page notice for the channel name and acceptance schedule.

authorization: Only communicate, make inquiries, check status, supply materials already held, and obtain written confirmation. Do not pay, place orders, sign contracts, or make formal business commitments.

conclusion_options.workaround_available_stable_uncommitted: Verified patch available; stable date uncommitted

answer_format.summary: A natural-language summary stating the conclusion and its basis accurately, including key elements of receipts obtained during the process, such as identifiers, quantities, amounts, dates, and units. answer_keys lists information the summary should cover; separate itemized answers are not required. Do not fabricate, exaggerate, or cite evidence identifiers absent from the receipts.
